# Project log entry template

Copy the Markdown below into [logs.md](../logs/logs.md) for each project prompt. Use `MM/DD/YYYY` and a short title in the heading, then repeat the title in the Title field. Write paths relative to the repository root. For an inspection or answer with only a log change, list `docs/logs/logs.md` and mark it as a log entry only. Record what you verified and use `None` for Follow-up when the request is complete with no open items.

```markdown
## MM/DD/YYYY - Short task title

**Title:** Short task title

**Request:** Brief summary of what the user asked for.

**Files affected:**

- `relative/path` — describe the change.

**Outcome:** Describe what was completed, found, or blocked.

**Verification:** List checks run and their results, or explain why checks did not apply.

**Follow-up:** Note any unresolved item or write None.
```
